text:
Checkout failed because the payment service connection was reset due to connection pool exhaustion

WHERE: checkout-api calling payments

.internal service

CAUSE: The checkout API attempted to charge a payment but the connection to payments.internal was reset after
750ms. The connection pool to the payment service was completely exhausted with 0 idle connections out of 32 total,

preventing the request from completing successfully.

EVIDENCE: 0000000000000003 | payment service call | POST to payments.internal returned 502 after connection

reset at 750ms
EVIDENCE: 7d807f489c68184ff2f29ec048e258dc-1 | pool exhaustion error | payments.charge failed due to connection reset, connection

pool shows 0 idle of 32 connections
EVIDENCE: 0000000000000001 | checkout failure | checkout-api returned 500 error stating

"upstream payment call failed"

SUGGESTION: Investigate why the payment service connection pool is exhausted - check if payments.internal is experiencing high load, slow response times, or connection leaks. Scale
the payment service or increase connection pool limits if capacity is insufficient.
